questions.question: When does the scheduled archival run execute?
Which revisions are eligible for scheduled archival?
questions.required_answer: Status approved and archive hold false.

questions.question: What happens when a revision has an archive hold?
questions.required_answer: Skip it, record the reason, and leave it unchanged.

questions.question: Who may clear an archive hold and what must they provide?
questions.required_answer: Only an operator assigned the ArchiveOperator role for fixture tenant A may clear it, with a nonempty reason; clearing does not itself archive the revision.

questions.question: What does an exact replay using the same logical request key return?

questions.question: What must happen before policy details are read for a request from another tenant?
questions.required_answer: Check tenant scope first and reject the other-tenant request without returning details.
